morphology.pattern_note: 外来姓氏整体记忆，不把 be- 或其他字母组合分析为马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为常见英国英语读法，并非马来语唯一标准读音；重音在第一音节。参见 [Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/beethoven)。

senses.zh_definition: 贝多芬：姓氏；在音乐语境中通常指德国作曲家、钢琴家路德维希·范·贝多芬（1770—1827）。
senses.en_definition: A surname, usually referring in musical contexts to Ludwig van Beethoven (1770–1827), the German composer and pianist.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang dalam konteks muzik lazimnya merujuk kepada Ludwig van Beethoven, penggubah muzik dan pemain piano Jerman.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正常拼写为 Beethoven；输入小写仅保留为词条键。不是马来语普通词，本条马来语释义为人物说明，并非 DBP 引文。karya Beethoven 指他的作品；口语中的 dengar Beethoven 常借人名指其音乐。人物背景参见 [波恩市官方介绍](https://international.bonn.de/microsite/en/services/information-for-media/beethoven-and-bonn.php?loc=en)。

dual_scenarios.en: The orchestra will perform Beethoven's Fifth Symphony at the opening concert.

etymology.historical_story: Beethoven entered Malay discourse as a European personal name through music education, performances and cultural writing. The composer's family had Flemish roots, and his grandfather came from Mechelen before working in Bonn. The family name therefore carries a migration story, while its modern recognition comes from the composer's music. It is not a formation built from Malay affixes. Sources: [Elbphilharmonie](https://www.elbphilharmonie.de/en/mediatheque/the-big-beethoven-abc/480), [City of Bonn](https://international.bonn.de/microsite/en/services/information-for-media/beethoven-and-bonn.php?loc=en).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记中文“贝多芬”，再把 Beethoven 整体对应到作曲家；用《第五交响曲》的开头节奏作听觉提示，不作词根拆分。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式节目单、报道和课堂材料中，首次出现可写全名 Ludwig van Beethoven，之后简称 Beethoven。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 姓名首字母须大写。欣赏古典音乐不代表社会身份高低，交流时宜说明作品或个人喜好，避免用音乐品味评判他人。
